Hi, I’m Slava I make simple games where something always goes a little sideways.

I make games with an unusual idea at the core: a mechanic or a setting you haven’t quite met before.

I like them minimal and easy to get into, with a challenge that is hard but always fair. Most of my time goes into the small details, the ones that pull you into the atmosphere and keep you there.

Say hi.

Questions, collabs, or a bug you found. I read everything.
